audit.ambiguity_policy: missing evidence, a changed hash, an unknown token, or a missing atom snapshot returns unavailable

method.atom_policy: the current LCC bridge is versioned by public patch; only a registered, time-safe snapshot resolves
method.lag_policy: retain the raw OE token; apply a dated correction only when a row has explicit live-realm evidence, because tournament realms may remain on the prior patch
method.oe_interval: deduplicate OE player rows by gameid, then group exact source patch tokens after the scope start
method.official_match: match the OE season minor to the official Riot patch minor, then require the first OE observation to be on or after the Riot patch-note publication time
method.time_safe_lookup: resolver requires as_of inside the hash-bound OE interval and on or after the official release

authority.exact_atom_snapshot: only rows with a registered snapshot and time-safe as_of
